static_traits.name: Lin Min
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues affected (tending to take blame for everything going wrong); has several friends, but unwilling to discuss these specific issues with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; no prior psychotherapy; no obvious physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Negative attitude, tending toward self-blame and perfectionism; clear expression, able to concretely describe automatic thinking; skeptical about change but still willing to try; worried about being judged

basic_info.main_problem: I have been experiencing forgetfulness and feelings of self-blame, especially when making mistakes.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of self-blame and forgetfulness are affecting my daily life and causing distress. I want to feel better and not be so harsh on myself.

core_beliefs: I must be perfect, any mistake means failure
I am not worthy of trust (because I am forgetful)

special_situations.event: A few months ago carelessly burning the coffee
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do simple things well, it means I am unreliable and incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to be more mindful and organized to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am very forgetful; I am incompetent and cannot be trusted

special_situations.event: Forgetting to grade Student homework on time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should always be perfect and punctual; if not, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing myself to pursue perfection, excessive Self-monitoring and taking blame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should do better; any mistake is unacceptable

special_situations.event: After leaving the keys behind, worries about forgetting other important things
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am forgetful on small things, I will surely make mistakes on important things in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks, raises vigilance, and organizes to prevent mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up again, next I will surely forget more things

special_situations.event: Colleagues noticing my Anxiety and trying to help
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they see my stress or mistakes, they will think me incapable and judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distances from or pushes away colleagues to avoid being seen and evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think me incompetent and look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as reliable and competent and to gain others' recognition and trust
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as incapable, being judged or rejected
defense_goal: Avoids mistakes and criticism through perfectionism
Taking the initiative to take blame to maintain control
Keeping distance from others to avoid judgment and shame

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / others ready to pick faults at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests exploring change and challenging self-blame and perfectionism
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client worries that once imperfection is exposed they will be judged incapable, thinking 'this has gone on too long; it may never change'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and supportive tone, acknowledging doubts and hardship; using open Questioning and invitations to small-step attempts; avoiding judgment and confrontation, encouraging concretized examples and reality testing.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When colleagues notice her Anxiety and proactively offer help or express concern
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client attributes inner self-blame and fear-of-judgment feelings to others, believing they will think her incompetent
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining gentle Clarification and validation, inviting evidence checking; using non-threatening counter-questions and Empathy reflection, distinguishing facts from speculation, encouraging limited openness.

manifestations: Pushing colleagues away for fear of being judged
Unwilling to discuss these specific issues with friends
Mistakes obscuring achievements (not treating daily teaching and never being absent as important)
Low sense of worth from self-evaluating as 'almost worthless'

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently using 'should' standards (e.g. 'I should be perfect, cannot make mistakes')
Demands high external standards of oneself while ignoring real differences

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing colleagues will judge her incapable and look down on her
Attributes one's own self-blame and shame experiences to others' thoughts

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Taking on excessive responsibility, overly self-demanding
Overly focused on mistakes and cautious, worrying about judgment and avoiding support

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of making mistakes or worrying about forgetting, the client usually falls into strong self-blame and Anxiety, disrupting daily routines and affecting Work and colleague relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the daily classroom teaching context, the client did not stall or avoid out of worry about mistakes as usual, but completed teaching tasks on time, never absent, maintaining stable Work performance.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different context — the fixed classroom structure and familiar teaching flow provide a clear framework; different actions — persistent organization and punctuality habits supported this deviation point.

positive_force: Strong responsibility and stable execution (daily teaching, never absent)
Willing to try changing (open but cautious)
Has tried mindfulness and more structured strategies
Has some social support (a few friends)
negative_force: Excessive personalization and self-labeling (attributing all mistakes to oneself)
Worry about future forgetting (predicting the future) causing sustained vigilance and unease
Fearing judgment and distancing from others, avoiding support

antecedent: Forgetting to grade homework on time
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionist value-conditions and overgeneralization, treating one mistake as overall incapability; fearing being judged incompetent
target_behavior.function: Tries to avoid external criticism and maintain a sense of control through self-punishment and high standards
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Increased anxiety, daily life disrupted, Work performance slightly affected

target_behavior.behavior: Pushes colleagues away in interpersonal interactions and avoids others' support
antecedent: Colleagues noticing her Anxiety and trying to offer help
Worrying colleagues will see one's stress or mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being seen as incapable, being judged and shamed
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and shame experiences
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships damaged, Increased sense of isolation, pressure maintained

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry and Anticipation about possibly forgetting in the future
antecedent: When thinking about tasks that need completing
target_behavior.core_reason: Predicting-the-future cognitive bias and catastrophizing tendency, aggravating worry about mistake consequences
target_behavior.function: Tries to prevent mistakes by raising vigilance and repeated checking
target_behavior.consequence: Daily rhythm disrupted, Anxiety persistent, Decreased efficiency
